certification.name: Certified Mobile Pentester - Android
certification.description: Four-hour practical exam on static and dynamic analysis of Android applications, using a supplied APK and flag-based challenges, taken online and on demand over a VPN. The certificate does not expire.
certification.currency_note: Vendor lists GBP only (GBP 250); converted at 1.3423 USD/GBP (ECB reference rate, 2026-11-10); frequent promotional discounts; one free retake included
